scope: Licensing and alternative-workflow source review. No external precheck was executed; no full-rule equivalence or foundry acceptance is claimed. No new third-party implementation was incorporated.

licensing_basis.finding: The Apache Software Foundation states that Apache-2.0 software can be included in GPLv3 projects. Required upstream license text and notices still apply.
The FSF distinguishes aggregates of independent programs from combined programs. Communication semantics matter; a separate folder or process is not an automatic compatibility exemption.

The U.S. Copyright Office distinguishes facts, systems and methods from protected expression. This is not permission to copy restricted code, manuals or layouts, or a determination about other rights or contractual restrictions.

Its public license grants use and redistribution rights subject to its terms. The earlier exclusion records unresolved GPL compatibility, not a finding that the license prohibits all public redistribution. No compatibility conclusion or incorporation is made here.

file_specific_license.interpretation: Preserve this file-specific GPLv3 grant; do not relabel it Apache-2.0 based on the repository root or claim an unprovided later-version grant.

technical_findings: The README describes a user-project precheck before shuttle submission, not certification of every historical SKY130 catalog entry.
The wrapper explicitly invokes separate FEOL, BEOL and off-grid profiles. Magic DRC is optional by default; all selected check switches and omissions would need to be recorded for qualification.
The inspected density deck computes whole-boundary clear-area fractions. It does not implement the missing 700 um waffle-conditioned density acceptance semantics.
No x.20 pin center-spacing limit or definitions for the named CLNTM, metop1-8, fomDummyDRC and RF model-map blockers were found in the inspected main SKY130 deck.
A passing precheck on a selected Caravel/OpenFrame harness would not by itself close the 302 unresolved catalog records.
candidate.potential_use: A separately named, pinned public-shuttle acceptance milestone and an independent comparison flow. Full Chunk 6 completion still requires a rule-by-rule applicability and execution reconciliation or authoritative acceptance evidence covering the missing requirements.
candidate.constraints: Do not silently replace the original complete-rule gate with this precheck. Do not claim it is integrated, executed, foundry approved for this application, or complete.

secondary_candidate.decision: A candidate template-specific public acceptance flow, not a replacement for complete catalog reconciliation. No new source files are incorporated.

repository_review.limitation: Bounded current-content and filename-history review, not a whole-repository legal audit. Binary contents, other wording, unavailable refs, ownership and patent rights are not determined by this scan.
repository_review.attribution_improvement: The source package already retains the Apache-2.0 seal-generator license and original files. Add an explicit central notice identifying the alignment checker adaptation and derived GDS controls so the attribution travels with desktop distributions.

path_forward: Keep application contributions GPL-3.0-or-later and preserve each compatible upstream component license and notice.
Use original implementations of sufficiently documented public requirements, together with compatible public engines and decks; retain exact sources and deliberately failing controls.

Evaluate the pinned public operator precheck as an additional milestone, with every skipped/optional check visible. Do not count it as the original gate without sufficient applicability and acceptance evidence.

Seek public version-applicable clarification or validated output/reference evidence for the remaining definitions. No private package, proprietary mirror or unverified relicensing is required or proposed.
Only promote full Chunk 6 when all required rules have documented coverage and passing evidence. Licensing compatibility and physical qualification must both be established.
